subject: Request: IR tabletop materials + SIG/CAIQ artifact window
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@fincontoso.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: IR tabletop materials + SIG/CAIQ artifact window

Hi Alex —

Following our security intake call, FinContoso and Redwood agreed to run a joint tabletop/forensics snapshot ahead of the SOC 2 audit next quarter. To keep this scoped, can you please: 

- Share a short artifact index (files and expected access method) covering IR logs, network forensics, alerting/export windows, and the current IR runbook extract that maps to SIG/CAIQ controls.
- Provide a 2-hour access window (SFTP, temporary read-only accounts, or signed link) where we can grab the snapshot and sample logs. We prefer a window the week of Oct 19; please list available slots.
- Note any PII/PHI constraints so we can scrub non-essential items before collection.

I attached a one-page Redwood IRP summary for context (redwood_irp_summary_v2.pdf). If there are contractual or NDAs needed for temporary access, flag them back.

Thanks — we want this to be lightweight and non-disruptive. Proposed next step: confirm an access slot and artifact index by EOD Wed Oct 14.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_irp_summary_v2.pdf (1 page PDF)

From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@fincontoso.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: security@fincontoso.com
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: IR tabletop materials + SIG/CAIQ artifact window

Vanessa —

Thanks for the clear outline. We can provide the following artifacts:

- IR runbook extract (PDF) mapped to SIG 1.0 controls
- Syslog and alert exports (7 days) in compressed CSVs
- IDS/Firewall flow summaries (sample)
- EDR timeline for recent detections (sample redacted)
- Audit log export for the user admin plane (90 days)

Constraints: we need to remove any payroll/HR PII before sharing and maintain a strict read-only pull via SFTP. We can open a 2-hour SFTP window on Oct 20 between 08:00–12:00 PT or Oct 21 between 13:00–17:00 PT. 

Link to our internal index (view-only): https://fincontoso.com/secure/irp-artifacts (will require the temporary account you mentioned).

Also note our security team requires acceptance of our limited-access Addendum; I can pull the standard form into DocuSign if needed. HubSpot ticket: HC-8974 is tracking the request.

Regards,
Alex Rivera
Security Operations Lead, FinContoso
alex.rivera@fincontoso.com

---
Sent from my phone; will follow up with the artifact index shortly.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@fincontoso.com>
Cc: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 14 Oct 2026 15:43:00 -0700
Subject: Final artifact checklist and collection runbook

Alex —

Quick follow-up with the compact checklist we will ask for during the Oct 20 08:00–10:00 PT window. We aim to minimize scope and remove any customer-sensitive fields before transfer. Please confirm this list and the preferred file naming conventions so we can script the pull: 

1) ir_runbook_extract.pdf (mapping table to SIG/CAIQ)
2) syslog_export_20261013-20261019.csv.gz (compressed, UTF-8)
3) alerts_export_20261013-20261019.csv.gz (include alert IDs and timestamps)
4) ids_flows_sample.csv (sample up to 48 hours)
5) edr_timeline_sample_redacted.jsonld
6) admin_audit_90d.csv (redact payroll fields)

If anything needs to be omitted client-side, call it out and we will skip. For transfer: SFTP read-only fetch, we will supply the public key and expect a SHA256 fingerprint on connect.

Also attached is a compact CSV we will use for final verification (final_artifact_checklist.csv). If you prefer an alternative transfer method (pre-signed S3 links), indicate which protocol and we will adapt.

Thanks for partnering on this — we will keep the forensic snapshot immutable and provide an MD5/SHA checksum report after download.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Security Evidence Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachment: final_artifact_checklist.csv (CSV)
